text:
sam_product: Draft PRD for "fallback + cross-model scoring" posted: https://go/internal/prd/fallback-scoring. Please review ACs, edge cases, and rollout approach before Friday planning.

devon_engineering: read-through. main infra risks: incompatible tokenizers and KV cache reuse. we need explicit cache invalidation rules and a plan for tokenization alignment or translation.

sasha_ml: agree. propose two calibration paths:
1) per-request z-score normalization on logits (fast)
2) periodic calibration against heldout eval corpus (more stable)
Both need metadata in logs so we can audit decisions.

mike_devex: API sketch:
```
POST /v1/chat/completions
{
  "model": "redwood-chat-v2",
  "fallback_policy": "latency|quality|none",
  "score_normalization": "none|zscore|calibrated",
  "messages": [...]
}
```

anya_product: draft acceptance criteria (short):
- documented fallback order for each policy
- normalization method validated vs eval set (thresholds defined)
- latency SLOs measured per-policy (p50/p95/p99)
- streaming: no token duplication; explicit switch points
- canary + rollback plan

devon_engineering: streaming note: we cannot transparently switch models mid-stream without re-encoding the prompt for the new tokenizer. options: only allow fallback between responses, or implement stitch-at-proxy which is risky. will detail in runtime section.

sasha_ml: add edge cases to PRD:
- empty/null completions from model -> trigger fallback
- exact score ties -> tiebreaker rule (prefer lower-latency or higher-quality)
- different max_tokens causing truncation
- embeddings shift when using embeddings for rerank
- user-specified model + fallback policy conflicts

mike_devex: SDK changes: add `fallbackPolicy` and `scoreNormalization` flags; defaults = `latency` and `none`. also add docs examples for streaming clients.

anya_product: can we include an acceptance test matrix? dims = policy x streaming x model-compat. each cell notes pass criteria and example test case.

sam_product: owners:
- PRD + acceptance matrix: anya_product
- runtime + cache migration: devon_engineering
- calibration + eval harness: sasha_ml
- SDK + examples: mike_devex

sam_product: timeline: feedback by Thu EOD, final signoff Fri 9am PT. ping me @sam_product for sync. :thumbsup:

devon_engineering: pushed a small PR with streaming constraints and cache TTL notes.

sasha_ml: added comment about calibration cadence: weekly for high-qps models, biweekly for mid, monthly for low.

mike_devex: queueing SDK PR after doc lock; ETA 1 sprint. will include migration notes.

anya_product: thanks all — will iterate the matrix and update doc tomorrow.

sam_product: great work. I'll pull this into the roadmap doc after signoff.
